name: Baked with Love
source:
After years living in the hustle and bustle of the metropolis, you finally decide it’s time to seek something more meaningful. Tired of the monotony and frantic pace, you board a train bound for Liurna, a small town that promises to be the perfect refuge.
As you explore the quiet streets and new surroundings, you find yourself entangled in unexpected encounters that could change the course of your life forever. Embark on this journey of acceptance, mystery, secrets and plenty of love.
While exploring Liurna, you’ll come across various different personalities, but one in particular stands out: an introverted, very shy, cute boy who loves staying at home playing video games and hates working.
